newsitem.title: UK: Chelsfield to raise 62.2 mln from new issue.
newsitem.headline: Chelsfield to raise 62.2 mln from new issue.

text.p: British property developer Chelsfield Plc said on Tuesday that it was planning to place 20 million shares at 317 pence a share to raise 62.2 milllion stg, net of expenses.
The money would be used to finance the acquisition of
Westbury hotels from leisure and media group Granada Group Plc.
The contract with Granada is expected to be completed on Tuesday.

Chelsfield is acquiring the Westbury Hotels in London and New York for 90 million stg. Chelsfield will also purchase the freehold of the London Westbury from AMP Asset Management Plc at a cost of 30 million stg.
The new issue would represent around 9.7 percent of the existing issued share capital of Chelsfield.
The placing has been fully underwritten by Hambros Bank Ltd while the brokers to the issue are de Zoete & Bevan Ltd.
